program_solutions:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((hh (rows g))
                  (ww (cols g))
                  (result (make-hash)))
             (for* ((r (range 0 hh)) (c (range 0 ww)))
                   (hash-set! result (list r c) (at g r c)))
             (for* ((r (range 0 hh)) (c (range 0 ww)))
                   (when
                     (= (at g r c) 1)
                     (when (> r 0) (hash-set! result (list (- r 1) c) 2))
                     (when (> c 0) (hash-set! result (list r (- c 1)) 7))
                     (when (< c (- ww 1)) (hash-set! result (list r (+ c 1)) 6))
                     (when (< r (- hh 1)) (hash-set! result (list (+ r 1) c) 8))))
             (build-grid hh ww (r c) (hash-ref result (list r c) 0))))))
